description: NASA POWER daily soil-wetness replay over the four southwest-Idaho lattice cells already established in agri.spatial_cell. Carries the three documented MERRA-2 soil-wetness depths (GWETTOP surface, GWETROOT root zone, GWETPROF profile) as a degree of saturation, not a volumetric water content. This is the keyless soil-moisture stream; the ERA5-Land volumetric path is blocked on a Copernicus dataset licence the account holder must accept in a browser. CONTINUATION 2026-08-08: HistoricalBackfillWindow requires an exact four-calendar-year span, so this plan's window necessarily re-covers most of the prior release's days under a new source_release_id; uq_signal_observation_release_cell_signal_time includes source_release_id by design and downstream covariate reads already DISTINCT ON (signal_name, day) ORDER BY data_available_at DESC (see plans/boise-trekker-rim-covariate-layer-and-first-model-2026-08-02.md). The only new ground covered is the window's final ~93 days; window end_date is the measured upstream frontier as of 2026-08-08, not a guess.
